title: Psychedelic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a wooden table, its black metallic base surrounded by scattered papers and purple ribbons. Inside the transparent sphere, a purple female silhouette stands beside a bright orb emitting vibrant, swirling rainbow tendrils that flow outward into the air.
prompt: A glowing crystal ball on a wooden table with black metallic base, inside a luminous orb emits long flowing colorful swirls of neon pink, green, orange, blue and purple that spiral outward from the sphere into the surrounding space, a translucent purple female silhouette stands inside the ball, cosmic starry nebula background in deep blues and purples, scattered papers and ribbons on the table, surreal psychedelic style, highly detailed, vibrant and luminous
